verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit is NVIDIA's official GPU-compute toolchain and is documented to target GPU-accelerated data centers/cloud platforms, with real-world confirmation of H200 SXM being used in production LLM workloads (Llama 405B inference). Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA compute-capability/supported-GPU list entry naming 'H200' by name and independent benchmarking against CUDA toolchain versions.
